## Reuse

The poems are licensed [CC BY-NC-ND 4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-nc-nd/4.0/). You may share a poem unmodified, with attribution and a link back. Beyond that licence, you may quote **one stanza** of any poem, with attribution and a link, unaltered. Copying text from a poem page adds the citation for you. To quote more, or to adapt, please get in touch.

The poems are archived and citable on [Zenodo](https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23230176).
